summary: M2 Security & Correctness Audit — 34/34 pytest passed. Verified tenant isolation, IDOR protection, backend RBAC, search authorization/scoping, audit export authorization, concurrent PATCH audit logging, soft-delete exclusion from dashboards/kanban/search, lead→customer conversion idempotency, double-click duplication behavior, and timeline immutability. Created tenant B directly via mongo (motor) with its own admin user, pipeline, lead, customer, contact, attachment, activity — verified NONE of them leak across tenants for tenant A superadmin. Two INFORMATIONAL findings (see below): (a) Direction dashboard is accessible with just audit.view (not restrictive enough per spec expectation); (b) Activities PATCH/DELETE returns 404 (route not registered) rather than 405 (route exists w/o method). Both functionally satisfy the immutability + RBAC intent but deviate from the exact spec assertion.

minor.issue: Uses require_any_permission('crm.leads.view','financials.view','audit.view'). Review spec (checkpoint 3) expected 403 for a user who only has audit.view — but implementation grants access. Direction dashboard exposes financial values (open_pipeline_value, weighted_pipeline_value, won_value_month) which are arguably too sensitive for an audit-only role. Recommend removing 'audit.view' from the require_any_permission set on this endpoint, or splitting the response into a redacted 'audit view' (no financials).

Returns 404 Not Found (path not registered) instead of 405 Method Not Allowed as review spec anticipated. Immutability is still enforced — no attacker can modify activities via HTTP. If the exact 405 semantic is desired, register /activities/{aid} with GET only so unsupported verbs raise 405. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Tighten GET /api/dashboard-crm/direction — drop 'audit.view' from the allowed set so only crm.leads.view or financials.view holders see financial pipeline aggregates. Currently a Viewer role user (audit.view only) gets 200 with all financial counters. Not exploitable across tenants (still tenant-scoped) but exposes internal financials to auditors.
OPTIONAL (cosmetic): If exact 405 semantics are desired on /api/activities/{id}, register the path with GET only. Current 404 is functionally equivalent (immutable).
critical_code_review_comments: activities router is correctly append-only — NO PATCH/PUT/DELETE routes exist for /activities/{id}. Direct HTTP verification confirms immutability (404 for all mutation verbs).
All CRM routers (leads, customers, contacts, attachments, activities, audit) consistently filter by tenant_id in list AND detail queries — no cross-tenant leaks observed.
search.py: every collection query includes tenant_id — verified tenant B's uniquely-marked activity ('TENANT_B_SECRET_NOTE') does NOT appear when tenant A superadmin searches for it.

dashboards_crm.direction: open_pipeline_value / weighted_pipeline_value / won_month all include 'deleted_at: None' in their queries → soft-deleted lead's estimated_value correctly excluded (verified empirically: value dropped by 5000 after soft-delete).
leads.convert_lead: checks doc.get('customer_id') before creating a new customer → second call raises 400 'Lead già convertito'. Verified customer count only increments by 1 across 2 convert calls.

Concurrent PATCH: two simultaneous stage-change requests to the same lead both return 200 and both produce a 'crm.leads.update' audit entry. Last-write-wins is the observed behavior (acceptable per spec).

Direction dashboard is guarded by require_any_permission('crm.leads.view','financials.view','audit.view'). Since Viewer role has audit.view, Viewer can call this endpoint and receive financial aggregates. Per review spec this should have been 403. Recommend narrowing to ('crm.leads.view','financials.view') only.

No export endpoint (CSV/PDF/XLSX) exists in M2 for audit/leads/customers → nothing needs additional auth. When M3 adds exports remember to gate them behind an explicit '<module>.export' permission (currently only audit.view / view keys exist).
Login endpoint validates emails via Pydantic EmailStr which rejects .local/.test/.example TLDs — tests must use routable TLDs when creating synthetic users.

leads.py PATCH: won_at/lost_at are NOT cleared when moving BACK from a won/lost stage to an open one — carried over from iteration_2; not tested here but still holds. Won_month counters count all leads whose won_at is set, so a resurrected lead still counts as won for that month. Consider clearing on transition to non-terminal stage.

rca of the issue: No blocking issues to RCA. The direction-dashboard-with-audit.view deviation is by design (M2 chose require_any_permission for maximum flexibility); can be tightened before M3 without breaking tests. The 404-vs-405 on activities mutations is a FastAPI routing artifact — the router simply doesn't declare /activities/{id} at all, so Starlette returns 404 before method-check; functionally identical to immutability.
